h: Pastor Adeboye blesses his granddaughter on her wedding day in Baltimore
p: The General Overseer of the RCCG, Pastor Enoch Adeboye, and his wife travelled to Baltimore in the United States for their granddaughter's wedding. Photos and videos of the ceremony and his blessing have been widely shared. Church members sent congratulations online.
more: The couple were seen praying with the newlyweds.
Many Nigerians in the diaspora attended.
Congratulatory messages poured in from church members.
